Approach

Hospitality begins before the door opens.

A stay includes more than an available room. AvanBnB focuses on the interactions between hosts, guests and the property itself, bringing the wider Avan approach to trust into short-term accommodation.

Shortlets, apartments and hotels

A hospitality platform across different types of short-term accommodation.

Identity and verification

Stronger participant and property verification supports trust around a stay.

Host and guest interaction

Secure interactions form part of a more accountable accommodation experience.

Arrival and access

Work on digital check-in and modern property access connects the online journey to the physical stay.

AvanBnB belongs to the wider Avan ecosystem. Platform capabilities and availability evolve as the initiative develops.
